description: Probes an x402 endpoint: reachability, TLS, latency, the 402 response and whether its payment terms parse and make sense. Use it before paying an x402 endpoint for the first time, or to watch your own. Give its URL; returns whether it answers, its 402 payment terms and every fault found. Paid per call: 0.50 USDC on Base over x402, no Agoreum account. Call it without payment to get the terms (an isError result holding the x402 PaymentRequired object), then call again with the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"]; the settlement comes back in _meta["x402/payment-response"]. Nothing is charged if the check fails or the payment does not settle. list_agoreum_tools lists all six with examples.

url.description: The https URL that should answer 402 Payment Required.
